note: Season = the year the season ends (2005 = 2004-05). Winners only: voting placements are not stored. coverage.<award>.status has one letter per season from 1996-97 (V verified by two or more sources, S one source, D derived, P partial, - missing).

champion.basis: played in a playoff game for the team that won the title (game results); the team's title is cross-checked against independent sources

ring.basis: listed as a member of the championship team (Finals MVP lists or an import); not a full roster list
